memo: Validation only, CPU, no submit. The MMP gain shrinks with parent distance (class-3 sim: no cut +0.13, parents < 0.7 Tanimoto +0.07, < 0.5 +0.025; truth generated 0.286 / 0.119 / 0.053), which matches e2gpu-2 not moving the LB: one-step MMP cannot reach a novel hidden class 3. New component (ours): FP-guided multi-step MMP walk. From the parents, any rule (30 most frequent per member) up to 3 steps, keeping the 10 intermediates whose bits fit the predicted FP best; every depth is also closed onto the target mass; the 30 best closed products by FP fit are added on top of the 100 MMP ones (8 s per molecule). Same setup as e2hard5-1 (cut 0.5) + beam=10. Pass: truth generated >= 0.15 and MRR@25 gain >= +0.07 over the no-MMP rows.
message: e2beam-1: FP-guided multi-step MMP walk on the 0.5 class-3 sim
